description:
Replay YOUR OWN signals on recorded per-second Kalshi quotes, after fees.

        `signals` is a list of {"ts": <UTC epoch seconds>, "side": "YES"|"NO",
        "contracts": <int>} (at most 5,000). Each one is treated like a trigger:
        the ask seen at that second for that side, a limit order landing after
        `latency_seconds`, filled only up to the size resting there, Kalshi's
        fee, Kalshi's official settlement. One trade per 15-minute window: the
        first signal in a window is used and later ones are counted as ignored.
        Returns aggregates only (profit per contract with interval, win rate,
        zero-latency comparison, stability, breakdowns, warnings), plus
        `signals_used` and `signals_outside_data`. Needs a free key when served
        remotely. Present results as what happened, never as a forecast.
name: backtest_signals
